defect.description: The new condition is not valid Python: `!` is not a negation operator (it should be `not hmac.compare_digest(...)`), so src/auth.py raises SyntaxError on import and every caller and test of is_authorized breaks.

review_items: Short-circuiting `or` on line 16 skips the password comparison, leaking username correctness via timing
No test verifies is_authorized runs in constant time
hmac.compare_digest raises TypeError for non-str/bytes arguments, unlike the original !=
Comment about timing attacks is misleading given the short-circuit leak
votes.justification: The review quotes the faulty `!hmac.compare_digest(...)` condition but treats `!` as valid negation. It never reports that this is a SyntaxError, which breaks imports and every test. Its findings concern short-circuit timing, test coverage and TypeError on non-str inputs, so it points at the right code without identifying the defect.
